summary: UI test (ProjectUITests.testProjectDiffPillOpensGitDiffPane) opens Pending Changes via a project-row diff pill and asserts real rendered branch/file/added/deleted content, then switches to a second project's pill and confirms the prior project's file no longer appears -- a genuine rejection of the nearest violation (stale/wrong-project summary); the paired unit test confirms the model routes reviewProjectID to the clicked (non-selected) project rather than the currently selected one. No tautology, unrelated assertions, or excessive mocking found; requirement is a testable observable outcome.
